verdict.rationale: Weave is an LLM observability and evaluation platform with a Playground for testing models, so consuming MCP tools is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only covers the opposite role: the official W&B MCP Server lets external coding agents connect to Weave data. That server-side capability does not transfer to this MCP-client story, and nothing shows Weave connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools.
